dedupe_keys.name: cartes de bruit strategiques des reseaux routiers et ferroviaires non concedes directive europeenne 2002 49 ce

description: Cerema publishes strategic noise maps for the 2022 assessment of non-concession road and rail networks in France, excluding the Métropole du Grand Paris. The description explicitly identifies modelled exposure of populations to noise from land transport infrastructure. Cerema produced the modelling with Université Gustave Eiffel. The outputs help identify affected zones, estimate exposed populations and inform environmental noise prevention plans. Departmental distributions contain noise zones for Lden and Lnight, including the source's type A and type C maps, where those networks were modelled. The description also identifies Shapefile maps, spreadsheet tables and document metadata inside the departmental packages. The source warns that the results depend on modelling assumptions and cannot replace a detailed local acoustic study or measurement campaign. The listing states a five-year update cycle and 2022 coverage. Files and individual departmental coverage have not been inspected. This record describes model outputs and does not assert that executable modelling software is distributed. An Open Licence is stated in the native metadata. No directly related catalogued record has been established.
